obtained.how: no full text: closed at the publisher (Taylor & Francis; TAFS is now with OUP), no repository copy known to OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar, not in the Internet Archive (no TAFS 1974 volume) or OSTI. Only the abstract was seen, via the OpenAlex API

Booth (Oct 1974), TAFS 103(4): 786–798. show.mjs reports 'DOI NOT FOUND at Crossref' only because the ledger tool cuts the DOI at its first '('; the DOI in references.md is right

claims.claim: the FB4 bluegill adult set (CEQ 2, CA 0.182, CB −0.274, CQ 2.3, CTO 27, CTM 36; REQ 2, RA 0.0154, RB −0.2, RQ 2.1, RTO 36, RTM 40, ACT 1; SDA 0.172; EGEQ 2 FA 0.158, FB −0.222, FG 0.631; EXEQ 2 UA 0.0253, UB 0.58, UG −0.299; ED 4186) and juvenile set (CTO 31, CTM 37, RTO 37, RTM 41) are from Kitchell et al. 1974
claims.note: These are exactly FB4's 'Bluegill sunfish (adult)' and '(juvenile)' rows, which FB4 credits to Kitchell et al. 1974 (see Deslauriers_etal_2017.json). Kitchell et al. 1977 printed its perch rates in biomass equivalents, which FB4 converted (Kitchell_etal_1977.json), so RA, UA and ED may well be FB4's conversions too. Until the 1974 paper is read, cite 'Kitchell et al. 1974, as given in FB4'

claims.claim: the bluegill set (Kitchell et al. 1974), whose respiration exceeds measured pumpkinseed values by ≈ 20–70 % (one study; project arithmetic)
claims.note: The bluegill side of the arithmetic, from FB4's stored row (ACT 1), for a 30-g fish: 38.8, 58.8, 88.4, 130.7 and 188.6 mg O₂ kg⁻¹ h⁻¹ at 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 °C (my computation; see Deslauriers_etal_2017.json). The pumpkinseed side is Roberts 1964's entry

claims.claim: pumpkinseed: bluegill (Kitchell et al. 1974), adult respiration × 0.7 (Roberts 1964)
claims.note: the × 0.7 is the project's adjustment; only the base set is attributed to Kitchell et al.

notes: The abstract (OpenAlex) says the model's 'parameters were implemented for the bluegill' and compared with laboratory and field data, so the bluegill values should be in the paper. A good stand-in for the parameter values, already read: FB4's parameter file (Deslauriers_etal_2017.json), where every value the code uses matches. The Fish Bioenergetics 3.0 manual (Hanson et al. 1997) may also document the bluegill model's sources and conversions.
